## Description

Couples recurrent neural networks with multivariate Hawkes point processes to forecast order arrival intensities, dynamically adjusting inventory skew and quote spreads in real-time.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency limit order book market making, volatile spread widening regimes, inventory risk management.

## Vehicles

HFT Market Makers, Crypto Prop Trading Desks.

## Required data

Level 2/3 limit order book message feeds, trade fills, inventory position metrics.

## Caveats

Real-time inventory skew adaptation requires low-latency C++/GPU inference execution.
